items.effect: Posting has declined three straight weeks (270, 168, 97, 42) and active creators fell to 37 from 67, so content supply keeps shrinking and affiliate GMV lags it by 2 to 4 weeks.
items.action: Run a reactivation blitz this week for the roughly 30 creators who posted Aug 24-30 but not Aug 31-Sep 6, offering bidet and screen door incentives.

items.effect: Orders fell 48.5% alongside units and AOV rose to 29.87 from 23.82, so demand contracted while the mix shifted to the higher price bidet.
items.action: Confirm next pull whether the Aug 31-Sep 6 bucket is partial, then reset weekly order and unit forecasts before planning sample or ad volume.

items.effect: Views have declined three straight weeks (1,098,089, 872,730, 448,318), though views per video rose to 10,674 from 8,997, so fewer videos drive the drop.
items.action: Push active creators to at least 2 videos per week and brief the highest reach formats from creative_brief to rebuild aggregate reach.

items.effect: Affiliate GMV fell 36.8% and LIVE GMV 31.2% with total GMV at its lowest in 4 weeks, so the drop is broad across channels and may be a partial week.
items.action: Verify the bucket on the next pull and hold GMV Max spend allocation until the confirmed level, keeping Shop Wide paused.

items.effect: Shipped samples have fallen three straight weeks (56, 49, 26) while 75 applications sit To Review, so delivered samples and the content they feed will keep shrinking.
items.action: Clear the 75 To Review applications within 48 hours, prioritizing post rates over 90%, and ship approved samples immediately.

items.metric: GMV Max Shop Wide ROI (1.0 breakeven)
items.effect: The campaign returned 430.79 on 623.62 of spend, so it is cash negative on ad spend alone and sits below its 2.0 ROAS target.
items.action: Pause Shop Wide and reallocate budget to Bidet 7/6 and Screen Door, which ran at 1.358 and 1.398 ROI.
